newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine industrial production up 8.1 pct - FIEL.
newsitem.headline: Argentine industrial production up 8.1 pct - FIEL.

text.p: Argentina's industrial production rose 8.1 percent in April from the same month a year earlier according to revised figures released Monday by the FIEL private consultancy.
Industrial production was up 4.4 percent from a month earlier while production in the first four months increased 7.7 percent from the same period a year earlier, said FIEL.
In earlier figures out last week, FIEL had industrial production in April up 7.9 percent from the same month in 1996 and up 7.6 percent in the first four months of the year.

"This rise is partly explained by the fact that there were more working days in April than in March...given that Easter usually falls in April rather than March as was the case this year," said FIEL, referring to the 4.4 percent rise in April from the previous month.

FIEL said that during the first four months of the year, eight of the 19 industries measured in the production index rose more than the average industrial growth, four increased less than the average and production in seven sectors declined in the period compared with the same four months in 1996.
